# Data Preparation

---
## Read packages

```{r read packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggwordcloud)
```

---
## Read post-experiment questionnaire data
```{r}
setwd('~/Desktop/ProjectsTracks/FRP_EventSegment/Analysis') # set your current working directory
seg_strategy_raw <- read_csv("segmentation_strategy/segmentation_strategy.csv")
```
---

## Tidy data
```{r}
# separate reported strategies into different columns
seg_strategy_cat <- seg_strategy_raw %>%
  separate(strategy_cat, 
           into = c("strategy_1", "strategy_2", "strategy_3", "strategy_4"),
           sep = ",\\s*",
           fill = "right",
           extra = "merge") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("strategy_"),
               names_to = "strategy_num",
               values_to = "strategy_category",
               values_drop_na = TRUE) %>%
  select(!strategy_num)

```

---

## Summarise data
```{r}
# number of strategies mentioned per participant
strategy_summary <- seg_strategy_cat %>%
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  summarise(n_strategies = n_distinct(strategy_category),
    strategies_used = paste(
      sort(unique(strategy_category)),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    .groups = "drop")
strategy_summary

# average strategies mentioned by each participant
mean(strategy_summary$n_strategies)
```

## Visualization
```{r}
# create word frequency summary
strategy_frequency <- seg_strategy_cat %>%
  filter(!is.na(strategy_category),
         strategy_category != "unspecified") %>%
  distinct(subject_id, strategy_category) %>%  # count each participant once
  count(strategy_category, name = "frequency") %>%
  mutate(
    freq_percent = frequency / sum(frequency),
    strategy_label = gsub("_", " ", strategy_category)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(frequency)) %>%
  mutate(
    strategy_label = gsub("_", " ", strategy_category)
  )

strategy_frequency

# create ggplot
Fig2_c <- ggplot(
  strategy_frequency,
  aes(
    label = strategy_label,
    size = frequency, 
    colour = frequency, 
  )
) +
  geom_text_wordcloud() +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 12) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "H") +
  labs(
    subtitle = "Word size represents the number of participants mentioning each strategy"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

Fig2_c

# Save as a 6‑inch‑by‑6‑inch square, high‑resolution
ggsave("Fig2_c.png", Fig2_c, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```
